title: The path, by version
rows: First org design locked: the first machine, with a nightly chain.
A research corpus built and a preregistration locked before any result was looked at.
First language builder seat: a Kotlin builder that gets a real checkout.
Six language builders; a pull request's language picks the seat.
The orchestrator wakes, decides and changes plans.
A site lane and pipe for the public site.
definition: Dated events from commit history, one line each, oldest first.
caveat: Entries marked earlier measurement come from the first machine (v1) and are not re-measured.
